title: Video provenance manifest (PRD-031 / RFC-033, S0)
description: Per-video attribution + fair-use record for every clip Orrery LINKS (never hosts). Videos of launches/broadcasts are copyrighted (unlike NASA stills), so this is a sibling of link-provenance, not image-provenance: we record the source, we do not download it. Generated by scripts/build-video-provenance.ts from static/data/video-sources.json; consumed by validate-data, the runtime data layer ($lib/video-provenance.ts), the MediaPlayer facade, and the /credits + /colophon pages.

schema_version.description: Bump this in lock-step with breaking changes to the entry shape.

commit_sha.description: Repo HEAD at generation time. May be null in dirty trees.

id.description: Stable hash-derived id `vid-<hash(provider|provider_ref)>` — independent of ordering + caption edits, so the manifest survives reorder/rename and the same source video dedupes.

entity_id.description: Id of the mission / launch-site / fleet asset / landing site that owns the clip. Every entity `videos:[{id}]` ref must resolve to an entry with this entity_id.

entity_kind.description: Which family owns the clip. 'live-pin' is reserved for the P2 permanent live feeds (e.g. the ISS stream); P1 uses the other four.

provider.description: Embed backend. Selects the MediaPlayer adapter + the embed-URL builder.

provider_ref.description: youtube video id, vimeo id, or an absolute media URL for agency-hls/agency-mp4. NOT the watch page — that is source_url.

source_url.description: Canonical watch/detail page (canonicalised — no utm_*, fbclid, gclid). Shown on /credits + /colophon.

channel.description: Uploading channel/account. MUST resolve in scripts/video-channel-allowlist.ts (official agency channel or a named trusted third-party).

agency.description: Operating agency/publisher the clip depicts (NASA, ESA, JAXA, ISRO, CNSA, Roscosmos, SpaceX, Blue Origin, …). Drives the global-agency parity report; may differ from `channel` (e.g. a trusted third-party channel covering a CNSA launch).

title.description: Human-readable clip title (English baseline; locale overlays translate it).

caption.description: Optional one-line context (authored; translated via the content i18n path).

kind.description: Clip category. 'animation' is the honesty hook — CGI/animation is labeled distinctly from real footage.

poster.description: Hosted PD/CC poster still served by SvelteKit (relative to /), OR null to use the provider thumbnail at runtime.

duration_seconds.description: Clip length when known (drives the duration chip).

start_seconds.description: Deep-link into a moment; the player seeks here on load.

license_or_fair_use.description: License id (e.g. 'PD-USGov', 'CC-BY-4.0') OR a fair-use rationale for a copyrighted embed (required for trusted-third-party channels).

content_advisory.description: null for ordinary footage. 'loss-of-life' (Challenger/Columbia/…) forces a click-through interstitial before the embed mounts (RFC-033 V-H); 'graphic' uses the same gate with different copy.

last_verified.description: ISO date the source_url + provider availability were last confirmed (author-recorded initially; refreshed by the link-checker later).

notes.description: Author notes (regional restrictions, alternate uploads, verification confidence).
